name: fill_biome
title: chunk:fill_biome
lead: Sets the biome of every column in a box, clipped to the chunk.
signature: chunk:fill_biome(from: Vec3, to: Vec3, biome: string)

usedIn.quote: --   chunk:fill_biome(from, to, biome)   the biome of each column in a box
chunk:fill_biome(chunk.min, chunk.max, "jungle")    -- each column of a box, clipped to the chunk
